text:
Elena (Chief Compliance Officer): Quick executive note: as part of prep for the upcoming ISO audit in Q3, were running a short-focused privacy & evidence alignment sprint next week. Two asks for all teams by EOD Friday the 8th (6 days): 1) Attend the 30-min "Privacy in Product" sync (recording will be posted) or complete the 15-min on-demand module; 2) designate an Evidence Owner for your team and post the owners name in this thread (format: team-name: Owner Name).

Marcus (Security): Clarifying scope: this covers any assets that could contain customer identifiers or sensitive config (public READMEs, demo buckets, dashboard screenshots, test datasets, third-party spreadsheets). If your team has delegated projects or contractors, owners must cover those too.

Priya (People Ops): People Ops will collect the owner list and ping managers directly for any teams that do not respond. Evidence Owners will receive a short checklist and a 1-hour office-hours slot to walk through uploading artifacts to the Evidence Vault.

Sam (Engineering Manager): For Evidence Owner responsibilities, whats the minimum?

Lina (Legal): Minimum duties: confirm any DPAs for contractors, ensure artifacts (demos, playbooks, runbooks) have metadata + retention, and verify no production PII is exposed in examples. Owners do not have to be the technical lead but should be able to coordinate within the team. Well provide templates.

Marcus (Security): Quick pragmatic tips for different asset types:
- Git: add a line to scrub_status.md `evidence_owner: Name` and tag sensitive files with `PII-scrubbed:true`
- Notion/Confluence: add page properties EvidenceOwner & EvidenceLink
- S3: add object tag `EvidenceOwner=Name` and `EvidenceStatus=attached` for uploaded artifacts

Priya (People Ops): Were publishing a short owner checklist: https://redwood-internal.company/docs/evidence-owner-checklist.pdf and the training link: https://redwood-internal.company/training/privacy-in-product. Office hours: Tue 11am PT & Thu 2pm PT in #compliance-office-hours.

Elena (Chief Compliance Officer): Small policy update to note (effective immediately): any public-facing example that contains real customer identifiers must be removed or replaced with synthetic data before it can be cited in product docs. This is to reduce audit remediation scope.

Sam (Engineering Manager): Quick Q: if we already have an internal script that anonymizes examples, is that acceptable or do we need to re-upload to the Evidence Vault?

Marcus (Security): If the script reliably anonymizes and you can produce a short note in the Evidence Vault describing the process + location of the script, thats fine. EvidenceVault expects either the scrubbed artifact + script link or the scrubbed artifact + scrub metadata (who ran it, when).

Lina (Legal): Contractors: managers must attach contractor DPAs (if not already on file) or confirm contractor IDs here: `team-name: contractor1, contractor2`. Well follow up for missing signatures.

Sam (Engineering Manager): Team: Feature Platform: Jamie Parker (evidence owner), contractors: none.

Priya (People Ops): Noted @Sam. Well DM any follow-ups.

Elena (Chief Compliance Officer): To make uploads simpler were also enabling a small API endpoint for Evidence Vault. Example curl for teams who want to programmatically register artifacts:
```bash
curl -X POST https://evidence-vault.internal/api/v1/artifacts \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EVIDENCE_API_TOKEN" \
  -F "file=@artifact.zip" \
  -F "team=feature-platform" \
  -F "owner=Jamie Parker" \
  -F "notes=demo dataset scrubbed, retention=2y"
```
Notes: tokens are provisioned by People Ops after owners are registered.

ComplianceBot: Reminder scheduled: owner registration due in 6 days. Auto-reminders at 72h, 48h, and 12h before deadline.

Marcus (Security): Enforcement note: non-responsive teams will be flagged in the Compliance Dashboard and their managers will receive a follow-up. For any high-risk public exposures we may disable public links after a 24h notice.

Priya (People Ops): Well post a brief follow-up in #eng and email managers with the owner roster tomorrow. If youre a manager and need an exemption window due to active launches, reply with dates and well coordinate.

Elena (Chief Compliance Officer): Thanks — this is a focused, short ask to tighten our audit readiness. When you post your owner please use the exact format `team-name: Owner Name` so automated collection works. Appreciate it.
